**Build is clean.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw `TypeError` on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) treated unset `backoffEnabled` as invalid instead of `false`, since the new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`.

The rest was deprecation noise from the bumped packages, not errors. Build now finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors.

Next: nothing. Build succeeds.
